kerneldir.description: Path to the kernel source directory (often empty for pre-built modules)

rtplib_dir.description: Directory where realtime kernel modules are installed

kernel_vers.description: Kernel version string (often empty if auto-detected)

debug_level.description: Default debug level for LinuxCNC components

modpath.description: Path to the realtime kernel modules

rt_version.description: Realtime system version identifier (3, 4, or 5 for specific RTAI/Preempt-RT configurations)

modules_rt3.default: adeos rtai_hal rtai_ksched rtai_fifos rtai_sem rtai_math
modules_rt3.description: Space-separated list of realtime modules for RT version 3

rtaimode_rt3.description: RTAI mode flag for RT version 3 configuration

modpath_adeos.description: Custom path for adeos module if not in default location

modpath_rtai_hal_rt3.description: Custom path for rtai_hal module in RT version 3

modules_rt4.description: Space-separated list of realtime modules for RT version 4

rtaimode_rt4.description: RTAI mode flag for RT version 4 configuration

modpath_rtai_hal_rt4.description: Custom path for rtai_hal module in RT version 4

modpath_rtai_sched_rt4.description: Custom path for rtai_sched module in RT version 4

modules_rt5.description: Space-separated list of realtime modules for RT version 5

rtaimode_rt5.description: RTAI mode flag for RT version 5 configuration

modpath_rtai_hal_rt5.description: Custom path for rtai_hal module in RT version 5

modpath_rtai_sched_rt5.description: Custom path for rtai_sched module in RT version 5

modules_rtai.description: Space-separated list of realtime modules for auto-detected RTAI kernel

modules_default.description: Default module list when no specific RTAI/Preempt-RT kernel is detected
